root_cause.where_identity_paragraph_is_emitted: src/tower/kernel_dialogue_adapter.py :: symbolic_reply() (~line 2380) f-string body: 'I am QSB Kernel, version ... Leading beliefs: ... Local symbolic interpretation: The kernel is active and stable. Local model routing may be used only as a speech layer if localhost Ollama is available. ...'
root_cause.why_it_fires_for_failed_intents: Topic detection (_wants_eqsb_topic) had triggers for ~25 topics but no recent_upgrades, godot_native_status, missing_features, or learning_evidence topic. When no topic matched and intent != IDENTITY, ask_kernel appended base_reply (identity paragraph) as the safety-net fallback.
root_cause.why_claude_changes_worked: code_observatory topic exists (added earlier) with triggers including 'what did claude change last' / 'claude changes'. That topic block reads eqsb_last_claude_change_summary + eqsb_phase_changes_latest, so the V2 smoke test's claude_changes question matched and printed a real block.
root_cause.sidecar_vs_shell_route_difference: scripts/qsb_kernel_chat.sh runs `python3 src/tower/kernel_dialogue_adapter.py` directly — same code path used by the smoke test. Sidecar (port 8766) was not the source of the failure; the adapter itself was missing topics.

identity_paragraph_now_fires_only_when: intent != EXECUTION_REQUEST AND no topic block was produced (safety net so reply is never empty)
